_comment: Tag -> vanilla keyword. Which keyword a perk mod is actually looking for
when it asks HasMagicEffectKeyword. Adding these to a modded effect the
librarian recognised is what makes perks fire on spells nobody patched.
Keywords are only ever added, never removed, and only when the load order
already contains them. The 'match' object takes the same conditions a
classification rule does, and it is there to keep a keyword off effects it
would be wrong on: MagicDamageFire belongs on a fire bolt, not on Conjure
Flame Atronach, which is also tagged fire.
Deliberately conservative. Every entry here has to be a keyword vanilla
itself puts on that kind of effect, because a perk condition written
against vanilla is the only thing this helps.

adapters._: elemental damage - the biggest win, every destruction perk tree reads these
conjuration - what kind of thing was called up
illusion - the influence keywords gate the illusion perk line
shape - runes and cloaks are gated separately from their element
